overview: Studios, one- and two-bedroom homes share landscaped recreation areas. Executive variants appear in the floorplates.
research.locationNote: DLRC, Dubailand, near Academic City and Dubai Outlet Mall; no fixed journey time is guaranteed.
research.priceNote: No live developer price published. Property Finder shows AED 675,000 in its headline and AED 628,000 in its launch narrative; neither confirms availability.
research.paymentNote: Historical December 2024 booking calendar shown; current Imtiaz FAQ retains the same 50/50 structure. Confirm revised dates and selected-unit terms.
research.handoverNote: Imtiaz expects December 2026; Property Finder retains January 2027. These are forecasts, not certified completion.
